import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    category_mapping = {"accessories": "Accessories", "Furnture": "Furniture", "office supplies": "Office Supplies"}
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].replace(category_mapping)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Region'])
    return df

def answer(df):
    category_means = df.groupby('Category')['Price'].mean().to_dict()
    overall_mean = df['Price'].mean()
    category_means['all'] = overall_mean
    return category_means
